label: Wait
description: Pause this branch for a number of seconds, counted from when the node starts waiting; the run parks on a timer at no cost (a run that cannot pause, such as a route still answering its caller, holds its worker instead, up to its trigger's `holdSecs`). `value` passes through unchanged. To wait for a date, use WaitUntil.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: `value`, emitted once the wait is over.

then.message: Wait '{id}' waits zero seconds. Give `seconds` a value above zero, or remove the Wait.
